summary.text: Lewis Mizrahi, a Republican and Conservative Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in New York's 8th Congressional District to Hakeem Jeffries, receiving 19.7% of the vote to Jeffries's 78.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

Ballotpedia reports that he advanced from both party primaries without a contest, that he also sought the Republican nomination in NY-9 but was disqualified there, and that he has not completed its Candidate Connection survey.
Little public biographical or campaign material about him could be found.

sources.title: U.S. House New York's 8th Congressional District results 2026
